description: This file defines the SubPanel class used in SuiteCRM to manage subpanel UI components, including rendering, search, configuration, and related data handling.

classes.name: SubPanel
classes.description: Represents the subpanel component in SuiteCRM, handling layout, data retrieval, rendering, and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SubPanel instance with module, record ID, and layout definitions.

methods.name: setTemplateFile
methods.description: Sets the template file used for rendering the subpanel.

methods.name: setBeanList
methods.description: Assigns a list of beans associated with the subpanel.

methods.name: setHideNewButton
methods.description: Controls visibility of the 'New' button in the subpanel.

methods.name: getHeaderText
methods.description: Returns the header text for the subpanel (currently empty).

methods.name: get_buttons
methods.description: Generates HTML for subpanel action buttons.

methods.name: ProcessSubPanelListView
methods.description: Prepares and executes data retrieval for the subpanel, returning HTML or query.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the rendered subpanel content or count.

methods.name: getModulesWithSubpanels
methods.description: Lists modules that have subpanel definitions.

methods.name: getModuleSubpanels
methods.description: Retrieves available subpanels for a specific module.

methods.name: saveSubPanelDefOverride
methods.description: Saves customization overrides for subpanel definitions.

methods.name: get_subpanel_setup
methods.description: Retrieves subpanel configuration for a specific module.

methods.name: getSubPanelDefine
methods.description: Retrieves combined default and custom subpanel definitions.

methods.name: buildSearchQuery
methods.description: Constructs search query based on form inputs for filtering records.

methods.name: get_searchdefs
methods.description: Returns search field definitions for a module.

methods.name: getSearchForm
methods.description: Generates the search form HTML for filtering subpanel records.
